name: value-utilities/decoration-placeholder-content
description: Three families I'd missed: `text-decoration-color/thickness` (`decoration-red-500/50`, `decoration-2`, `decoration-[3px]`, `decoration-auto`, `decoration-from-font`), `placeholder-<color>` emitting on `::placeholder` with the standard alpha-variable color path, and `content-<value>` (and the static `content-none` reset) using the `--tw-content` cascade var so users can compose `content: var(--tw-content)` rules. Mirrors upstream's `textDecorationColor`, `textDecorationThickness`, `placeholderColor`, and `content` plugins.
